facts.fact: FAO's GIEWS country brief for the Republic of the Congo, reference date 23 June 2026, reports from satellite-based imagery that precipitation has been adequate and well distributed since December 2025 in most croplands, and lists GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring among its tools.
